trigger.description: The memory_anchor_index reverse-index generation is behind the workspace DB generation when ee recall runs (memories changed since the derived index was last maintained), so results may miss recent memories. Repair: ee index rebuild --workspace . (ADR 0064 §5).
setup_commands: ee remember "Anchored rule about src/db/mod.rs" --workspace . --level procedural --kind rule --json
# advance the DB generation without refreshing the derived anchor index
